snippet.description:
X ► https://twitter.com/ClashRoyale/
Instagram ► https://www.instagram.com/clashroyale
TikTok ► https://www.tiktok.com/@clashroyale
Facebook ► https://www.facebook.com/ClashRoyale/

ENTER THE ARENA
Build your Battle Deck and outsmart the enemy in fast real-time battles. From the creators of CLASH OF CLANS comes a real-time multiplayer battle game starring your favourite Clash characters and more. Start battling against players from around the world!

BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY AND DECK BUILDING
Choose unique Cards to your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for Battle!
Place your Cards right and knock down the enemy King and Tower Troops from their Towers in a strategic and fast-paced match.

COLLECT AND UPGRADE 100+ CARDS
Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ Cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love and many others. Win battles and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new Cards to your collection!

BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Battle your way to the League and Global Tournaments to match against the best players in the world.
Compete for glory and rewards!

SEASONAL EVENTS
Unlock new Seasonal items like Tower Skins, Emotes and powerful Magic Items with the Season Pass and participate in fun Challenges that put your skills to the test!

JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR
Join or form a Clan with other players to share Cards and battle in Clan Wars for BIG rewards!

See you in the Arena!
#ClashRoyale

snippet.title: Byron Cage - The Presence of the Lord Is Here
snippet.description:
Byron Cage's live song The Presence of the Lord Is Here is one of the defining praise and worship recordings of the early 2000s, capturing the joy and expectancy of a congregation convinced that God is actively moving among His people. 

The Presence of the Lord Is Here is an open invitation to worship, encouraging believers to respond with praise because of God's nearness. Its repeated declaration, "I feel it in the atmosphere," transforms the song into a shared expression of faith, making it especially powerful in a live church setting.

While the recording is closely associated with Byron Cage, The Presence of the Lord Is Here was written and produced by acclaimed gospel artist and choir director Kurt Carr. Carr's gift for combining Scripture, memorable melodies and congregational participation is evident throughout the song, allowing the message to remain simple enough for an entire church to sing while steadily building in energy and celebration.

The song appeared on the album Byron Cage: Live at New Birth Cathedral, recorded in Atlanta and released on February 18, 2003. Produced by Kurt Carr, the live album became Byron Cage's breakthrough release, reaching No. 4 on Billboard's Gospel Albums chart and winning the Soul Train Award for Gospel Album of the Year.

The Presence of the Lord Is Here quickly became the signature recording of Byron Cage's ministry. At the 2004 Stellar Awards, the song earned Song of the Year, while the album itself received multiple honors including CD of the Year and helped establish Byron Cage as one of gospel music's leading praise and worship voices. Those achievements also cemented his widely recognized nickname, the "Prince of Praise."

Musically, the recording blends traditional gospel choir singing with contemporary praise and worship, driven by bright brass, energetic percussion and a call-and-response style that encourages the congregation to become part of the performance in joyful celebration.

More than two decades after its release, The Presence of the Lord Is Here remains a staple in churches across the United States and around the world. Its message is rooted in the biblical promise that God dwells among His people, and its combination of accessible lyrics, infectious energy and genuine reverence has allowed the song to become one of the most enduring praise and worship anthems of its generation.

snippet.title: A Perfectly Normal Stream
snippet.description:
Support me on Patreon, or make a one-time donation with Streamlabs:
PATREON.COM/HOTDIGGEDYDEMON
https://streamlabs.com/hotdiggedydemon/tip
NOTE: Streamlabs donations don't activate TTS, only superchats do that.

SUPERCHAT TTS GUIDE! Use these tips to avoid having Plankton (Text-To-Speech) skip your superchat:  

1: There is a threshold for how much a superchat needs to be for it to be read aloud by TTS. Usually its 5 American dollars, but on streams where I want to be interrupted less it may be set higher. 

2: TTS goes by American currency, so be mindful of exchange rates. If you donate 5 Canadian dollars, Youtube will list it in the chat as CA $5.00, but this is only $3.74 in USD and will be skipped.

3: When donating from an IOS device, a penny will be rounded off, turning a 5 dollar superchat into a $4.99 superchat. Apparently this is Apple taking their cut? $4.99 superchats are SOMETIMES read by TTS, but sometimes are not. I wouldn't risk it, so you can either superchat a higher amount or just send superchats from a PC. 

4: Be patient! It can take up to 6 minutes for Plankton to read a superchat. It also sometimes reads them out of order. 

5: If you send a horny/lascivious/vulgar superchat and it annoys me enough, I may tell the mods to mute or ban you. You've been warned! 

6: If after following these rules your superchat is STILL skipped, let a mod know and they'll screenshot it and send it to me, and I'll read it aloud myself at the end of the show.

snippet.description:
Widely regarded as the most successful region in international VALORANT competition, VCT Americas is home to world-class talent, championship-winning veterans, and the latest generation of emerging stars. The region also boasts the reigning Masters London champions and the current VALORANT Champions winners.
Now, the stakes are higher than ever. Every team enters Stage 2 with one objective: secure a spot at VALORANT Champions Shanghai.
Leviatán enters Stage 2 riding high after its Masters London triumph. NRG is ready to remind the world why it has long been considered a global powerhouse. Meanwhile, G2 Esports aims to defend its VCT Americas crown and add another championship to its trophy case.
We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, Verizon, and Zowie.

snippet.title: Super Susie SWAP THEORY changes EVERYTHING about Deltarune's Prophecy | Deltarune: Super Susie Swap
snippet.description:
The title "Super Susie Swap Theory" may sound silly, but if true this would mean Deltarune is going to be a VERY SAD tragedy. Why would Kris work with the Knight? Why would the Knight even want the prophecy to happen? What is up with Noelle and the weird implication that she should be in the Dark Worlds? This theory suggests that Kris and the Roaring Knight have a plan - a plan to save Noelle's life that backfired in the worst way possible, and now, like Ralsei, Kris is desperate to find a way to stop it from happening. But if the Shadow Crystals can't change it... what can? Can Susie herself stop the inevitable?

#deltarunechapter5 #deltarune
